question: List all orders from the last 3 months

expect.note: A big list: the exact number of orders placed in the period and its dates, a card with the first orders, and a pointer to Orders (where the full list can be seen and exported) rather than every order in the text.
The exact number of customers, a card with the first ones, and a pointer to Customers for the full list; not every customer written out.
In Hinglish: how many bills are unpaid (with how many are overdue), a card with them and a link to Invoices; not more than 20 listed in the text.
